title: First Nations Cancer Scholarship
degree: Postgraduate Certificate, Master's, PhD, Honours, Graduate Certificate, Research Postdoctoral
program_type: Charitable foundation and government co-funded research scholarship (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander graduate students)
duration: Up to three years, with no need to re-apply each year once awarded
description: Established by the Aurora Education Foundation and Cancer Australia, and funded by the Australian Government through Cancer Australia, the First Nations Cancer Scholarship supports Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander graduate students, health professionals and early-career researchers to undertake full-time postgraduate study or research in a cancer-related field, valued at up to AUD 120,000 per year for up to three years.

title: Swinburne Research Stipend Scholarship
duration: Three years of stipend, with a possible six-month extension; tuition fees covered for up to four years
description: Swinburne Research Stipend (SRS) scholarships are awarded to candidates of exceptional research potential undertaking doctoral studies and are provided to assist with general living costs; successful applicants are automatically awarded a scholarship covering tuition fees for up to four years.

title: ACIAR Pacific Agriculture Scholarship Support (PASS) Program - Fiji National University 2027 intake
official_source: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR), PASS Program administered at Fiji National University
duration: 24 months for Master's students, 36 months for a PhD candidate
description: ACIAR's Pacific postgraduate scholarships are offered in the Pacific, to Pacific Islanders, enabling scholars to research agricultural problems within the context where the solutions need to work; the PASS Program aims to strengthen the Pacific agricultural innovation system through the strengths of Pacific universities and their regional partners.

title: Bond University Postgraduate Research Scholarship
duration: Living stipend for 3 years, which cannot be extended beyond that term; fee waiver for 4 years
description: Bond states it 'values its higher degree research student cohort and provides a substantial level of direct financial support to many students', allocating funds to support the financial costs of fee offset (waiver) and living stipends, and notes that stipends 'are intended to support candidates with their day-to-day expenses and do not include tuition fees'.

title: ACU Stipend Scholarship
duration: Stipend and full fee offset for the duration of the research degree, to a maximum of 3.5 years for a PhD
description: ACU states it 'offers ACU Stipend Scholarships to support both domestic and international candidates undertaking a Research Doctorate or Research Masters degree', with a package comprising a living allowance stipend, a full fee offset, and for international applicants a health care policy and relocation allowance.

title: Western Sydney University Research Scholarship - Spring Release, Quarter 1 2027 commencement
duration: Stipend for three years; tuition fees covered for the degree duration
description: Western Sydney University states it 'receives a high volume of applications and scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis', with Spring Release scholarships for Quarter 1 2027 commencement including a $38,707 (AUD) stipend per annum for three years and tuition fees covered by the Australian Government Research Training Program.

title: Arab Fund Fellowship for Academic Excellence (برنامج الزمالات للتميز الأكاديمي)
official_source: Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development (AFESD)
duration: Usually 12 months; shorter periods are considered only in very special cases
description: Since 1997 the Arab Fund's Fellowship Program has empowered Arab scholars with excellent academic track records to conduct advanced research and/or academic activity at prestigious universities, building bridges between Arab and foreign academic institutions; about 191 scholarships have been awarded since inception.
